facts.business: Lloyds Engineering Works Limited designs, engineers, and manufactures hydrocarbon and process equipment such as pressure vessels, heat exchangers, columns, reactors, air dryers, and waste heat recovery systems for refineries, petrochemical plants, and chemical facilities in domestic and international markets.
